name: Sales view passes Orderfacts.linecount through unchanged
note: First coverage of a VIEW. Views are the consumption surface for Superset, DBeaver and Angular, and until now nothing tested one. A view can differ from its underlying cube in ways no cube-level case reaches, because it introduces joins that the cube itself does not perform. This asserts the plain passthrough: Sales.linecount must equal Orderfacts.linecount over the same window, 110,854.
referenceSql: SELECT count(*) AS value FROM c_order o JOIN c_orderline ol ON ol.c_order_id=o.c_order_id WHERE o.ad_client_id=1000026 AND o.processed='Y' AND o.isproposal='N' AND o.dateordered >= DATE '2026-01-01' AND o.dateordered < DATE '2026-09-01'
